verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Identity supports webhook-based outcome handling ("Listen for verification results so your integration can automatically trigger reactions") and programmatic access to verification results, satisfying the no-polling reaction pattern. However, the pack never shows signature verification details or explicitly enumerates the created/processing/verified/requires-input event lifecycle. Missing for 10: explicit webhook signing/verification documentation, enumerated event-type list, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the full lifecycle firing correctly.
